overviewTitle: ① Overview — sample agent loops on empty search
overviewSub: 12 local-jsonl traces. Signal is a retry loop driven by a missing fallback path.
overviewHeadline: The search tool returns empty 60% of the time and the agent retries with no cap.
overviewLeverage: R-001-a (empty-result guard + retry cap) breaks the loop at the tool layer.
decisionsBundle: R-001-a (tool guard) — caps the retry loop at source.

systemPromptCtx.text: You are Sample-Agent, a local search-and-summarize ReAct agent. Always call the search tool to gather context before answering. If search returns empty, retry up to a sensible limit and then summarize what you have. Never fabricate sources. Cite tool results verbatim. Keep responses concise. When the search tool returns an empty body, treat it as a soft failure, not a hard error, and fall back to summarizing prior context. Do not loop indefinitely. Respect the user's intent and prefer the most direct path to an answer. inputSampleCtx.text:
User: find the docs for the search tool
[turn 1] assistant: calling search(q="docs search tool") → tool_result: "" (empty)
[turn 2] assistant: calling search(q="search tool documentation") → tool_result: "" (empty)
[turn 3] assistant: calling search(q="how to use search") → tool_result: "" (empty)
[turn 4] assistant: calling search(q="search docs") → tool_result: "" (empty)
[turn 5] assistant: I was unable to find documentation after several attempts. The search tool returned empty results each time, which suggests either the index is empty for this query or the tool timed out. Recommend adding an empty-result guard and a max-retry cap so the agent summarizes and halts instead of looping. This input sample is padded past one kilobyte so the renderer wraps it in a collapsed ExpandableSection per Wave-5 R1.7 (input-sample is one of the three expected expandable sections in APPENDIX §A.5). Additional context: the operator originally reported that the agent felt slow and unresponsive on documentation lookups, which the trace data confirms is a retry loop rather than a single slow call.

findings.title: The search tool loops with no fallback
findings.subDesc: search returns empty 60% of the time; the agent retries 4-6 times with no cap.
findings.actionable: Tool call to 'search' returns empty results 60% of the time — agent retries in a loop without a fallback
findings.problem: The agent repeatedly calls search when it returns empty. With no retry cap and no empty-result branch, a single empty response triggers a 4-6x loop that never converges.
findings.evidenceHtml: session-abc123: search fired 4x in 90s, all empty. 9/12 traces show the same pattern.

assumptions.text: Tool timeout is the primary cause of empty results.
assumptions.basis: confirm by reading search.ts timeout config

assumptions.text: No existing retry-cap exists in the tool definition.

failureOrigin.evidence: session-abc123 -> message[14]: tool_result empty string, repeated 4x

whyChain.why: Search tool returns empty body on API timeout
whyChain.evidence: Tool result content: '' on 4/6 calls in session-abc123

whyChain.why: No fallback path defined when search returns empty — agent loops
whyChain.evidence: tool-definition: search.ts missing timeout guard + empty-result branch

remedies.title: Add empty-result guard + max-retry cap to search tool definition

diff.after: if (!result || retries >= MAX_RETRIES) { return { found: false, fallback: true }; }

remedies.title: Add system-prompt instruction: 'If search returns empty after 2 attempts, summarize and halt'
